---
title: "Evidence Audit"
---

The evidence audit surface renders selected review packets from canonical JSONL
records. These pages are for human review and navigation; they are not the
canonical evidence store.

Canonical evidence records live in `projects/sacrificial-debt/data/` and must
validate before they are used in claims, publication tables, or exported
evidence chains.

## Sections

- [Packets](packets/) lists rendered evidence review packets.
- [Negative Evidence](negative-evidence/) summarizes records that weaken,
  qualify, or falsify proposed mechanism claims.
- [Rival Explanations](rival-explanations/) summarizes competing explanations
  linked to propositions or evidence references.
- [Claims](claims/) will list promoted research claims when any exist.

## Current Packet

The first rendered packet is the Segall 1922 pilot calibration packet:

[sd-packet-000001](packets/sd-packet-000001.qmd)

It uses Jacob Segall's 1922 statistical study of German Jewish soldiers as a
Germany/Judenzaehlung counterevidence source. The packet is reviewed for pilot
calibration, not expert-adjudicated, not a released finding, and not strong
Sacrificial Debt evidence.
